title: Is This Your Fun Bike? | Carbonda CFR 696 | Oompa Loompa Cycling E86

takeaways.text: At about 165 cm the owner rides the 49 cm (490 mm) size with 160 mm cranks and a short-reach bar; 38 mm Gravel King tires on 19 mm internal rims measure about 40 mm, run at 27–28 psi.
Chosen as an endurance-style road bike that can also do gravel; the owner finds it very comfortable on road, mostly thanks to the wide tires, but not built for outright speed.
A Singapore owner paid US$988 direct for the frameset with fork, seatpost and a custom paint scheme arranged with the seller (2022).
His mixed GRX/Ultegra 2× build weighs about 9.2 kg without accessories or bottles, per the owner.

disclosure: An owner brings their own CFR696 to the creator for an interview; the description promotes channel membership and mentions no brand sponsorship.
summary: Singapore owner interview about a road-leaning CFR696 build on 38 mm tubeless tires at about 28 psi, covering why they chose it, the more aggressive than typical gravel geometry, mounts and use on broken roads.
